subject: "Permission denied" error when accessing external executable

messages.author: 34829a22d38269cb
messages.subject: "Permission denied" error when accessing external executable
parts:
Dear all,

I run a shiny app with TreeTagger (linguistic parser). The app passes a character vector to function treetag() (part of the koRpus package), which then accesses the external TreeTagger installation, which is included in the app directory. Everything runs perfectly locally. However, on shinyapps.io, I get the following error message:

"An error has occurred. Check your logs or contact the app author for clarification."

In the log file, it says:

"2019-05-28T15:14:22.927336+00:00 shinyapps[952518]: sh: 1: ./TreeTagger/bin/tree-tagger: Permission denied"

This is the path to the parser executable. It seems the permission is denied. Any suggestions?

I use Ubuntu 18.04, R version 3.4.4.

Thank you in advance.
